title: Personal Property Found in Vehicles: Repossession and Collateral Recovery
content:
Personal property inventoried in a vehicle taken in under Repossession and Collateral Recovery is held free of charge (the holding fee is 0.00) and a personal property notice stating the claim deadline is mailed within 5 days after the recovery date; the claim deadline is the mailing date plus 30 calendar days.

Property is released to the borrower, or to a person the borrower authorises in writing, on the borrower's request at any time up to and including the claim deadline, whatever the status of the case or the contract and without any payment on the contract.

Property not claimed by the deadline is disposed of on the day after it (disposition: disposed after the hold period).

Each case's property is released or disposed of once; items attached to the vehicle (stereo, wheels, accessories) are part of the vehicle and are not personal property.

## Deadline boundary (hypothetical dates)

| Notice mailed | Claim deadline | Request made | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 August | 3 September | 3 September | released to the borrower |
| 4 August | 3 September | none by 3 September | disposed of on 4 September |

## Points of judgement

- A balance owing on the contract, or a sold or reinstated case, does not stand in the way of a release made by the claim deadline.
- A set of aftermarket wheels mounted on the vehicle is part of the vehicle, not property to be released.
- A person other than the borrower receives the property only with the borrower's written authorisation.
